# TI CC140xP transceiver host driver

Copied unmodified from TI's Zephyr fork, `simplelink-zephyr` tag `v3.7.0-ti-1.00.01_ga` (commit `cbababd4c1b4a1f1a844eb05ab798c0974518cb6`), on 2026-10-09.

- `host/`: `drivers/misc/ti_cc140xp/host/` without `hal/platform_spi.c` and `hal/platform_util.c`, the two files that use Zephyr's kernel, SPI and GPIO. Everything left is plain C. The same C is what the SimpleLink TRX plug-in ships (TI says it "can be ported to other MCUs").
- `ti_cc140xp.h`, `ti_bp_cc140xp.overlay`, `ti_cc140xp.overlay.example`: the Zephyr wrapper header and the shield overlay, for reference.
- `rcl_settings_wisun.c`, `.h`: the Wi-SUN radio settings from `samples/shields/ti_bp_cc140xp/ti_cc140xp_tx/src/settings/`.

License: BSD-3-Clause in the file headers (host/), Apache-2.0 (wrapper and overlay). TI marks as in the headers. Our replacement for the two Zephyr files is `portability/cc1407p-host/hal_bare.c`.
- `rcl_settings_2gfsk50kbps.c`, `.h`: the 50 kbps 2-GFSK radio settings from `samples/shields/ti_bp_cc140xp/ti_cc140xp_genfsk_tx/src/settings/` (same tag), copied 2026-10-10 for the G5187 sender.
- `settings/`: all twelve radio settings files from `samples/shields/ti_bp_cc140xp/ti_cc140xp_rf_diagnostics/src/settings/` (same tag), unmodified, copied 2026-10-11 for the G5187 PHY matrix (`mspm0g5187/radio/phy_matrix.c`). The PHY list itself follows that sample's `src/radio/trx/PhySettings_trx.c`.

The radio settings files (`rcl_settings_*`, `settings/`) are generated by SmartRF Studio and carry no header of their own. In TI's repository they fall under the repository license, Apache-2.0, copied beside them as `LICENSE-simplelink-zephyr` from the same commit (added 2026-10-13, licensing audit).
